draft.subject: PageFly — Japan rollout for localized landing pages
draft.body:
Hi PageFly team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama company supporting commerce technology firms in Japan. We’re contacting PageFly about localized landing-page iteration for Japanese Shopify wellness launch teams preparing campaign-specific product pages.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean launch teams, reusable page workflows can reduce repeated production work while preserving local review across campaign releases.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide page structure, approval steps, and localization priorities. Can we help plan and execute PageFly’s Japan rollout around this workflow?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
